description: What each platform will and will not accept: character limit, whether media is required, how many images, video formats and length, and EVERY per-platform option it takes — `options` per platform, each with its exact key, type, allowed values, default when left out, and whether it is required (e.g. Pinterest needs boardId, YouTube needs ytTitle and ytMadeForKids; YouTube's privacy is ytPrivacy, Instagram's first comment is firstComment). Call this BEFORE writing a post — it is the difference between composing something that publishes and something the platform rejects.
name: get_platform_rules
title: Get each platform's posting rules
